instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Design a module that implements a 4-to-2 priority encoder. The module should have four inputs, A, B, C, and D, and two outputs, X and Y. The priority encoder should encode the highest input that is active (high) and output a binary number representing the position of the active input, starting from 0. If multiple inputs are active, the priority encoder should encode the input with the lowest position.
label: clean
